review_description: We went with TINDO SOLAR.The sales/quoting process was as professional and efficient as you would expect from a long standing solar company.The fact that they are an Australian company with Australian assembled, if not manufactured, panels gave them the edge when it came to comparisons with other companies.The installation was impressive to say the least.Matt and Aaron arrived on time and started immediately.The installation was under less than favourable conditions, due to a very dusty, 30 something deg roof.A localised dust storm the day before being the culprit.The pair of them simply pushed on and kept their cool.The job was finished in a day, albeit, a long one.We couldn't have asked for a better installation, even with my constant hovering around and asking questions.Brilliant job boys!

Solar system purchased through Tindo Solar.  From the first contact through to the final installation, nothing but fantastic service.  No pressure to buy from this company, the sales rep Sanjeev, was a consummate professional, Daryl the customer service manager,  was over the top helpful, polite and was able to answer anything about the install, the panels, the inverter and any in-depth technical questions asked.  Tindo has certainly made a great impression that will be recommended to all friends, family and colleaguesWhilst the system is not the cheapest, it is about buying Australian made from a South Australian company, with all services from local South Australian companies, buying a quality system rather than just having a system.  Yes cheaper was available but that would mean compromising a very high standard and expectation and accepting second best.The installation was flawless and exceeded any solar systems I have seen previously.  Matt and Jake (installers) were polite, hard working, efficient and leaving nothing to chance and keeping us fully informed every step of the way. Their dedication to their job and profession exceeds the Australian standards. These two hard working professionals are a credit to Tindo Solar and their professional.. I cannot recommend more highly
